subject.title: fix: prevent dev watch rebuild loops after live git pulls

question: After refreshing this branch against current main, should the maintainer accept the metadata-driven generated-output contract as the canonical dev-watch boundary and merge it once the live-pull scenario is observed?
rationale: The author is a repository MEMBER and the PR has the protected `maintainer` label, so this cleanup workflow must defer landing judgment to a maintainer even though no discrete patch defect is established.

options.title: Refresh and validate before merge
options.body: Rebase or refresh against current main, capture a redacted terminal run of the live-pull scenario, and merge if generated outputs are ignored while ordinary source changes still restart.

options.title: Request a narrower follow-up
options.body: Keep the PR open if maintainers want a different long-term package-metadata contract or a smaller watcher-only fix.

recommendation.title: Refresh and validate before merge
recommendation.body: Rebase or refresh against current main, capture a redacted terminal run of the live-pull scenario, and merge if generated outputs are ignored while ordinary source changes still restart.
